column3: Close to the Hebrew; “a nation not loyal” is rendered “an ungodly nation.”
Close to the Hebrew; מָעוּזִּי (“my stronghold”) is rendered “my strength.”
Close to the Hebrew; “mountain of holiness” is rendered “holy hill,” and “dwelling places” “tabernacle.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the God of the joy of my rejoicing” is rendered “God my exceeding joy.”
Close to the Hebrew; “wait for” is rendered “Hope in,” and “salvations” “help.”
